Exophiala xenobiotica keratitis: Postoperative course was initially uneventful under topical and systemic corticosteroids
No conjunctival hyperemia, no discharge, and no epithelial defect
Eye infection had resolved prior to surgery
History of eye infection by Thaumetopoea pityocampa (pine processionary) 9 months before DSAEK
Slit-lamp biomicroscopy of the right eye showed brown, multilobular lesions confined to the deep corneal stroma
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography of the right eye revealed a central infiltrate involving all corneal layers
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography of the right eye revealed a peripheral infiltrate concentrated in the deep stroma
